comparison.objective: Insert a pipe into a fixture; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Pipe/fixture pose alignment and insertion versus recessed hex-key use, bimanual collar adjustment, force-limited locking, and repeated test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe must be inserted into the fixture; candidate requires quantified non-bottoming stops and no post-lock setting drift. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Generic constrained insertion does not test response-driven parameter adjustment or lock retention.
